propositions: merge.ours.driver is set per-clone in init.py but never committed, so it is undefined in the CI runner environment
reconcile-bridge.yml performs a bare git worktree add without calling rebar init, leaving merge.ours.driver unset and causing git to fall back to 3-way text merge instead of local-wins
reconcile-bridge-canary.yml obtains merge.ours.driver via its existing rebar init call and does not require modification
The undefined merge.ours.driver makes the reconverge path fragile when blob:none filtering occurs, as blobs are lazily materialized mid-merge
Setting merge.ours.driver=true in reconcile-bridge.yml before any merge step is required as a prerequisite for the CI clone filter (B1)
